localFacts.fact: Real Decreto 444/2024 (BOE): creators count as "usuarios de especial relevancia" and must register in the state registry only if they meet an income threshold AND have at least 1.000.000 followers on one video platform (or 2.000.000 across platforms) AND published at least 24 videos in the previous year. Most small streamers are outside it. General information, not legal advice; no currency amounts in the post.
Iberia allows one cabin bag up to 10 kg with max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; the Befree Advanced folds to 40 cm.
The K&F Concept is sold in Spain under the same code O234A1+BH-36 as "Trípode Cámara 163CM".
Vanguard (vanguardworld.es / .de) sells the EU ALTA PRO 263AB G2: 171 cm max, 69,5 cm folded, 2,29 kg, 10 kg load, column 0-180 degrees.
Local terms: rótula de bola, rótula fluida, columna central, zapata/placa de liberación rápida; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Ring light and phone on the same stand make the shot shaky and badly lit (common advice in Spanish creator content).
localPainPoints.fix: Put the ring light behind the tripod, not beside the lens; keep the phone on its own tripod (English setup section).

localPainPoints.pain: Solo hosts struggle to frame themselves before going live.
localPainPoints.fix: Frame from where you will stand or sit and run a private test stream for a minute (English steps 3 and 6).
